files.style.css: html,body,#game-root{height:100%;width:100%;overflow:hidden;margin:0}canvas{width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;touch-action:none}.hud{position:absolute;inset:24px 28px auto;display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #10203580;pointer-events:none}.brand span,.eyebrow{font:700 10px system-ui;letter-spacing:.22em}.brand h1{font:900 22px system-ui;margin:7px 0}.brand b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.35em;color:#ffdee4}.stats{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.stats span{background:#162438b8;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:30px;font-size:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}button{cursor:pointer;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 19px;background:#e93956;color:white;font:bold 13px system-ui;pointer-events:auto}.intro{position:absolute;left:7%;top:20%;max-width:400px;padding:32px;border:1px solid #ffffff40;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#142339ed,#27334ed9);box-shadow:0 25px 70px #0b152955;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);color:white}.intro[hidden]{display:none}.intro h2{font:800 clamp(28px,4vw,46px)/1.05 system-ui;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:20px 0}.intro p{font:14px/1.6 system-ui;color:#d0daed}.intro .keys{padding:14px;background:#ffffff0c;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px}.intro button{width:100%;margin:10px 0 16px}.intro small{font:10px system-ui;color:#acbbcf}.touch{position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:24px;right:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}.touch div{display:flex;gap:6px}.touch button{background:#17243bc9;border:1px solid #ffffff55;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);touch-action:none;user-select:none}@media(max-width:650px){.hud{inset:12px}.stats{max-width:140px}.stats span{padding:5px 9px;font-size:10px}.brand h1{font-size:16px}.intro{left:5%;right:5%;top:16%;padding:22px}.touch{left:8px;right:8px;bottom:8px}.touch button{padding:12px;font-size:11px}}
